context: Two colleagues assess a corporate client
purpose: Profile a big client; teach 不動産/所有/証券/兆/金利/供給/請求/保証

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あの企業、不動産を大量に所有してますね。
lines.en: That firm owns a huge amount of real estate.
lines.style: observant colleague noting the holdings, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、証券市場でも存在感があります。
lines.en: Yes, they’re prominent in the securities market too.
lines.style: informed colleague adding context, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 売上は一兆円を超えるとか。
lines.en: Their revenue reportedly tops a trillion yen.
lines.style: impressed colleague citing the figure, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 低金利のうちに設備投資を進めるようです。
lines.en: They seem to invest in equipment while rates are low.
lines.style: analytical colleague reading the strategy, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部品の供給網も自社で持っているんですね。
lines.en: They even own their parts supply chain.
lines.style: colleague appreciating the integration, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 取引先への請求も、システムで一括処理です。
lines.en: Even client billing is batch-processed by system.
lines.style: colleague noting operational maturity, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 万一のときの保証はどうなってます？
lines.en: What about guarantees if something goes wrong?
lines.style: cautious colleague checking the risk, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 銀行が保証していますから、安心です。
lines.en: A bank backs the guarantee, so it’s safe.
lines.style: reassuring colleague closing the concern, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
